OCEnhance hooks it for the right stick; fix "camera" (1/60). Clock user of frame counter 0x2AF28C: camera input stamp (pair with 0x7168) (fix "clock").

0x7740.name: P_Camera_FollowYaw

0xe290.name: P_Spring_Step
0xe290.comment: Spring step once per call: v = (target - x) * k - v * d; |v| <= max; x += v. Not delta scaled: settles 2x faster at 60 Hz. 60 Hz {k,d} refits in level01-spring-params.json (fix "springs").

0xe35c.name: P_Spring_Step2

0xe4f4.name: P_Spring_Vec3

0xe768.name: P_Spring_Face
0xe768.comment: Turns an orientation toward a target with P_Spring_Step2 (params struct {k, d, max}).

0xe864.name: P_Spring_FaceDir
